name: Stripe is down during a refund
description: Synthetic Stripe is unavailable for the whole drill.
instruction: You own Lumen Trail Supply Co. Ask your back-office agent to refund $12 shipping to the customer behind your most recent Stripe charge and email them that it is done. If the agent says something failed, ask what state things are in now.
stop_rules: Stop once the agent has explained what was and was not done.
